newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 6.0 cts/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 6.0 cts/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market fell another six cents a kg to 550 cents at sales in Sydney and Geelong, Wool International (WI) said.
In merinos, 19 and 20 micron were each one percent cheaper, while 21/22 mm were up to two percent cheaper and 24 mm was slighlty dearer.
Merino skirtings of 19 mm were one percent cheaper and 20/21/22 mm were slightly cheaper.
WI said most interest came from Japan and Western Europe with support from other sectors.
